message:
feat: add next manual Yandex route batch

15 more routes measured by hand in the free Yandex Maps web interface, one at a
time from 46.82388, 29.48313. No paid API, no scraping, no protection bypassed,
nothing invented. Miles converted x1.609344 without rounding the source value.

Batch: MY-001, MY-004, MY-005, MY-006, MY-007, MY-008, MY-009, MY-010, MY-012,
MY-013, MY-014, MY-015, MY-016, MY-017, MY-019 — every one carries a real Yandex
distance, duration, variant count, street list, entry, U-turn flag and OSRM
comparison. Progress is now 27 of 86 controls measured, 59 remaining, 0 blocked;
counts are recomputed from the files, not typed in.

Median Yandex-vs-OSRM divergence across all measurements is 3.3%. Two new rows
exceed 10%: MY-005 Студенческая 8 (15.3%, Yandex is SHORTER than our route) and
MY-019 Суворова 87 (25.0%). MY-001 and MY-004 confirm the Р2 путепровод corridor
again (Панина -> Р2 -> Петровского/Ермакова -> Титова), both with a U-turn.

Address discrepancies recorded, never applied to our address base: several Гиска
control points come back labelled "улица 40 лет МССР" or "село Гиска" where we
hold "улица Суворова"/"улица Ленина" — flagged STREET_NAME_VARIANT and
SETTLEMENT_DISAGREEMENT in manual-yandex-address-discrepancies.csv. Северный vs
Варница stays OWNER_BOUNDARY_DECISION_REQUIRED.

Also fixed: the id-repair script used to rewrite the migration file from scratch,
so re-running it after the ids were already correct erased the historical record
of the MY-002 split. The migration is now an append-preserving repair log, and the
test that assumed it was a per-measurement index was corrected to assert what it
actually is.

Not touched: zone_id, zone boundaries, Кишинёвская, immutable releases, Direct,
prices, the tariff matrix and the address base. 468 pytest pass; ruff clean.
